generated_native_abi.descriptor_note: Existing CARGO_PKG_VERSION-derived export metadata follows the workspace bump; it is distinct from the unchanged interface version 1.

dependency_and_abi.worker_protocol_extension: The new native privacy plugin supplies bounded request context/history_dir and explicitly flushes before shutdown. The new helper supports those optional fields and flush; pin core and compat together for the audited behavior.
dependency_and_abi.registry_publication_boundary: GitHub application releases and local path packages were verified. These release workflows do not establish publication of every Rust workspace crate to crates.io; this audit makes no such claim.

privacy_history.behavior: Bounded audit records and daily counters use the existing private-file boundary, a stable sibling interprocess lock, retained daily files, atomic counter replacement, a five-second counter flush and explicit graceful-EOF flush.
privacy_history.content_boundary: Records keep placeholder/category/source, bounded head/length/count/action and whitelisted context metadata. They do not persist the full original value, request body or restoration map; do not describe them as containing no information derived from input.
privacy_history.failure_semantics: Audit failure is reported while masking remains active. Counter retries use committed state to avoid double-applying deltas; this is not a guarantee that every failed detection-record append is later replayed.

native_context_and_shutdown.behavior: Existing typed ContextPlugin supplies bounded agent/session/path metadata. Request drop closes response state and requests helper flush; audit warnings are surfaced through the host.

history_cutover.behavior: Drains the old/new owner before transfer; verifies key/binding/source/candidate identities; prepares a durable private whole-tree snapshot; journals intent before Linux renameat2 exchange/no-replace; refuses independent writer drift and preserves displaced recovery copies.
history_cutover.scope: Linux desktop-user cutover with existing service/process/catalog/MCP verification. Cross-platform helper builds do not make this Linux service-migration script cross-platform.
history_cutover.test_boundary: These 17 new transaction/failure regressions use FakeSystem for service operations. They exercise real temporary filesystem/locks plus controlled races/crash points, not a completed migration of the user desktop.

builtin_entrypoints.behavior: Each legacy-host entry module exposes its initializer without also exposing helper functions that the host would mistake for additional initializers.
builtin_entrypoints.algorithm_change: Codeassist, Codex and Copilot implementation text is identical after removing the old default entrypoint and trailing whitespace; entry modules import the separate implementation.
builtin_entrypoints.tests: Real built-in initialization and empty MCP tool listing without credentials/network; legacy default/named initializer compatibility and alias deduplication. No live provider account success is implied.

core_formal.source_binding: Prepare job performs the release bump/tag; reusable release jobs check out the emitted tag and verify-ref it. The run entry head is not the final package source; tag and source archive independently bind b853.
